concrete.status: Generic constant hypotheses for a bounded sensitivity calculation; not measured WTC concrete properties.

reinforcement.status: Generic constant hypotheses. Alpha matches the cached V10W steel benchmark; density and heat capacity are not WTC-specific measurements.

concrete.law: Compression linear elastic until the fc domain screen; tension elastic then linear softening to zero. Irreversible max tensile strain, secant unloading to origin, restored elastic compression at closure. No crack healing or compression plasticity.
concrete.regularization: eps0=ft/E; epsf=2*Gf/(ft*Lch), require epsf>eps0. Total monotonic work per volume is Gf/Lch including the pre-peak triangle. Lch is longitudinal crack-band length, NOT slab depth or fiber thickness. No tensile residual stress floor.
concrete.status: E/fc/ft inherited hypotheses; Gf/Lch new uncalibrated sensitivity hypotheses. No measured WTC tensile fracture curve, cycle law or crushing law.

reinforcement.law: Symmetric elastic-perfectly plastic, associative 1D return mapping; no hardening, buckling, fatigue, rupture or rate effect. Perfect steel-concrete strain compatibility.
reinforcement.status: All steel areas, grade and layer placement are EXPLORATORY assumptions, not an actual WTC reinforcement schedule. The 1 percent strain screen is a chosen model domain, not measured fracture strain.

formulas.sensible_enthalpy: H=sum(rho*cp*A*DeltaT), J/m, separate from mechanical balance

constitutive_exclusions.constitutive_domain: Small-strain, plane-section, linear thermoelastic response with constant properties. No concrete cracking/crushing, steel yielding, creep, transient strain, bond slip, geometric nonlinearity or contact evolution.
constitutive_exclusions.temperature_field: Prescribed uniform or linear through-depth temperature change relative to 20 C. It is not obtained from a fire, heat-transfer, radiation, convection or SFRM calculation.
constitutive_exclusions.history_policy: No V11E/V11F damage variable or material property is edited. Heated fracture is excluded until temperature-dependent free energy, irreversibility and prior damage history are formulated together.
constitutive_exclusions.energy_policy: Mechanical Helmholtz energy and thermoelastic conjugate work are balanced in J/m. Constant-property sensible enthalpy is inventoried separately and is not inserted into mechanical work. No local energy receives global collapse credit.
